tips.text: Ask in Recruiting chat for a clan that finished all research; many let you join just to replicate the blueprints.
Stay in the clan afterward; the same labs hold other frames, weapons and archwings.
Research him in a small Ghost clan if you must; costs multiply with clan tier, up to 100 times.
Tell the clan you are low-activity and only want the Volt blueprints.
Players call Volt painless once a clan has him researched; finding that clan is the only real cost.
